description: This PHP class, BuzzPhotoDecorator, is part of the OrangeHRM project and serves as a decorator for the BuzzPhoto entity, providing additional functionality such as retrieving the photo resource as a string.

classes.name: BuzzPhotoDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for the BuzzPhoto entity that provides methods to access photo data, including converting resource streams to string.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the decorator with a BuzzPhoto object.

methods.name: getPhoto
methods.description: Retrieves the photo from the BuzzPhoto object, converting resource streams to strings if necessary.
